form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A unique name for these credentials. Other settings, such as HTTP TLS key stores, refer to credentials by this name.
Tick if these credentials have an expiry date, then set it in Expires.

form:FormGroup.label: Expires
form:FormGroup.helpText: The date and time the credentials expire. This is shown in the credentials list as a reminder; Stroom does not stop using them after this time.

form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The kind of credentials: Username / Password, Access Token, SSH Key, Key Store or Key Store File. The secret fields change to match. Default is Username / Password. The type can't be changed once the credentials have been created.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Username / Password, Access Token, SSH Key, Key Store or Key Store File. It can't be changed once created.

form:FormGroup.label: Key Store File Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: The path of the key store file on every node. To change it, use Replace Secret.

form:FormGroup.label: Secret
form:FormGroup.helpText: Once set, a secret is never shown again. To change it, select the credentials in the list and use Replace Secret.

g:Label.text: The secret is set but cannot be shown. Use Replace Secret to set a new one.
